client.name: Quillmark Legal
client.description: A 30-lawyer firm specialising in commercial contracts for mid-sized businesses.

engagement.goal: Explore whether an AI-assisted contract intake tool could reduce time spent on first-pass contract review.
constraints: Client data cannot leave the firm's approved cloud region

items.summary: Managing partner believes associates spend 'about a third of their week' on first-pass contract review and that AI could halve that.
An associate mentioned that clients often send contracts in inconsistent formats (scans, tracked-changes Word files, PDFs).
A vendor claims its AI review tool cuts first-pass review time by 60–80% at 'leading firms'. No methodology published.
